simple.meaning: עָצָב (ʻâtsâb) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an (idolatrous) image.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Samuel 31:9. The surrounding context includes family, blood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָצָב (H6091) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עָצָב (ʻâtsâb) / H6091 is traced through 1 Samuel 31:9, 2 Samuel 5:21, 1 Chronicles 10:9, 2 Chronicles 24:18 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols, and to the people.
They left their images there; and David and his men took them away.
They stripped him, and took his head and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to their idols, and to the people.
They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.
Their idols are silver and gold,
The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
They have set up kings, but not by me.
Now they sin more and more,
Who is wise, that he may understand these things?
All her idols will be beaten to pieces,

It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.
